selected.title: ANZ completes cross-border tokenised deposit payment with Swift ledger
selected.summary: Australia's ANZ has carried out a live corporate treasury transactions using tokenised deposits and Swift’s blockchain ledger.
selected.why: First live cross-border tokenised deposit payment by ANZ using Swift.

reason: ANZ's tokenised deposit trial raises arguable questions about whether Swift's blockchain approach will actually reduce settlement risk or merely add complexity to cross-border payments
angle: Tokenisation via blockchain ledgers may solve coordination problems that don't actually exist in modern correspondent banking, creating solutions in search of problems.
